rachel: rolling a small patch tonight 02:00 UTC: api=v2.3.5, runtime=v3.2.0-rc1, router unchanged. need quick ack and rollback owner. @tom @mei

deploy-bot: Window reserved 2026-09-01T02:00Z->02:30Z. Canary: 4% 7m -> 20% 10m. Auto-rollback: errors>4% for 5m or p50>250ms.

tom: ack router noop. i'll own router rollback if needed.

mei: runtime ack. i'll revert to v3.1.8 if we see regressions. on-call 01:50-02:20.

rachel: short rollback steps in notes: 1) stop shift (routerctl) 2) pin api back 3) promote runtime v3.1.8 4) notify support

deploy-bot: Canary started 4% at 02:00:00 UTC. Monitoring errors, latency, KV ops.

(02:06 UTC) deploy-bot: Alert: p50 increased to 310ms over 5m -> firing.

mei: seeing runtime KV miss rate spike. i'll start runtime rollback now.

tom: holding traffic. routerctl stop-shift -> done.

mei: running: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/runtime runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v3.1.8` -> rollout in progress.

deploy-bot: Runtime rollout finished, pods ready.
deploy-bot: Canary aborted and reverted. Wave marked ROLLED_BACK by rachel at 02:03:30 UTC.

rachel: thanks. mei please file BUG-3001 with traces and kernel logs. tom keep router pinned for 12h. i'll update release notes: "rc kernel path caused KV miss spike; reverted to stable"

mei: BUG-3001 created, attaching traces.

tom: leaving router pinned. will unpin after ops signoff.

rachel: closing wave. we'll add a lite kernel smoke to preflight. :thumbsup:

(END)
